quest.title: Suspicious Smuggling Case
quest.description: You decide to take a look around the Akademiya...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x525, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

talks.objective: Take a look around the Akademiya

dialogues.text: What should I do now? *sigh* If only Cyno was still around...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, excuse us, has something happened?
Oh, I appreciate the concern, but who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We also happen to know Cyno.
Ah, friends of Cyno! Well, I suppose it's not a secret or anything... Since you two are interested, I'll just lay it out for ya.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: My name is Nabil, I'm a matra in the Akademiya. A case involving the smuggling of Canned Knowledge has come to our attention recently, but unfortunately, we don't have the people to handle it at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean the Akademiya is short on matra right now?

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: Well, not exactly, I suppose the main problem is that the case suddenly came up after General Mahamatra Cyno left to go somewhere. It would be a real headache for us to tackle the case ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: Given the large scope of the issue, we talked things over internally and decided that we should find further assistance from outside the matra.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: If you two have some time, would you lend us your strength?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, alright. Since you asked so nicely, we'll help!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any further intel regarding this case?

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: Yes, large amounts of Canned Knowledge from unknown origins have been appearing on the market recently. We suspect there's a secret route being used to move the capsules.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: According to some research, using large amounts of Canned Knowledge could lead to some serious consequences, and unfortunately, most people have yet to realize that.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: Rumors also have it that some particularly dangerous Canned Knowledge has made its way into the market. Regardless of whether the rumors are true or not, this case calls for urgent action.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: According to our current leads, it's highly likely that there are dealers selling Canned Knowledge outside the city even as we speak. If you two could, please help us investigate the area.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You can count on us, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After searching outside the city for some time, you see a familiar figure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? It's Cyno! Uh, what are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two. I knew I sensed a familiar presence.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I'm currently in the middle of an investigation here. We'll have to chat some other time.

choices.text: So you're investigating something here, too?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: There's been a recent case of Canned Knowledge smuggling. It seems that the smugglers are following an elaborate and dangerous scheme. I just happened to acquire some intel which led me here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, whaddya know! We're also here to investigate that!

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I see, well the situation might be more problematic than you anticipated. I've already questioned several people, but gained very little information.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Long story short, I was able to learn of the secret location where the Canned Knowledge is being sold. You're welcome to accompany me if you're interested.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa, sounds pretty complicated... but having Cyno around will definitely make things easier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, let's go round up those bad guys!

talks.objective: Look for clues outside the city
Work with Cyno to arrest the suspects

dialogues.speaker: Mutair
dialogues.text: Is this all you got? Hmm, seems even less than last time.

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: What difference does it make? If you see somethin' you like, buy it. If not, then keep walkin'.

dialogues.speaker: Amenzu
dialogues.text: They've been cracking down on us lately, so we don't have much on hand. If you see something that catches your eye, then now's your chance. There's no telling when we'll have more.

dialogues.speaker: Mutair
dialogues.text: *sigh* What does the Akademiya think they're doing... Alright, I'll take these here. Lemme see what else you have...

dialogues.speaker: Mutair
dialogues.text: I don't see any real gems in this batch. It's all pretty ordinary stuff. Whatever, how much do I owe you?

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: 150k. Show us the Mora, and you'll get the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Put the Mora down and your hands up.

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: Ah! It—It's Cyno! Ugh, when's he ever gonna let up!?

dialogues.speaker: Amenzu
dialogues.text: Hey! Forget the goods, let's split!

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: But don't forget the Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Duh-dun! Not so fast! You can't escape with Paimon on the case!

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: What is this? He's got backup now? Doesn't everyone say Cyno works alone?

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: Uh, I don't like the looks of this... Either way's gonna be a tough fight. Any ideas?

dialogues.speaker: Amenzu
dialogues.text: It's over. It's not like we're making a big cut anyway, I'm not losing my life here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Did they really just give up like that?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Just like the others I've caught. They're not deep in the circle, just dealers at the bottom of the chain.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Alright, I have one question, and one question only: Where did you get this Canned Knowledge?

dialogues.speaker: Amenzu
dialogues.text: Well, uh, the pickup location is different every time... The boss tells us where it's gonna be and that's it. We don't get a say in it. He sends someone every five days to bring us the goods.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: And when is the next batch coming?

dialogues.speaker: Amenzu
dialogues.text: I—I don't know.

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: He's telling the truth, honest! Normally, we should have received a shipment three days ago, but we didn't get anything.

dialogues.speaker: Amainu
dialogues.text: The stock we have right now is from eight days ago, which is why there isn't much left.

choices.text: Seems this isn't getting us anywhere.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I know exactly why they didn't receive their last batch. Three days ago is exactly when I started my investigation.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I suspect whoever's running this whole thing knew that I was coming, so they cut all contact with these dealers.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: When you were trying to escape, you said something about me working alone. Where did you hear that from?

response.speaker: Amainu
response.text: Are you kiddin'? We've known your name since day one in this business. The boss warned us to watch out and even gave us info about you.

response.speaker: Amainu
response.text: But here we are... *sigh* I guess we never stood a chance.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hmph, they already knew all about me and were trying to avoid being detected from the very beginning.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: These small fries are the only ones they leave out in the open, and no matter how many we catch, it won't further our investigation.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: If only we had another lead... like a merchant who sells large amounts of Canned Knowledge.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Oh, you mean someone like Dor... uh, nothing...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Hmm? Do you have a potential suspect? You'd better bring them to me for judgment!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—Whoa, judgment!?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: That's right. I won't turn a blind eye on any dangerous suspect.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, uh, sounds like we shouldn't ever let Cyno meet Dori...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I see. Anyway, I'll think of a way to deal with these two and then continue gathering information.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: If you manage to learn anything, you can find me at Caravan Ribat.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: And as for you, I don't ever want to catch you buying Canned Knowledge again. If you possess any unused Knowledge Capsules, then you should submit them to the authorities immediately.

response.speaker: Mutair
response.text: Okay, okay, I got it... Just keep your nose out of my business.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, what's with the attitude, mister!

response.speaker: Mutair
response.text: What, you got a problem with that, too? Listen, buying Canned Knowledge is a deal between two people: the buyer and the seller. We don't need people like you butting in on our business here.

response.speaker: Mutair
response.text: Think about it. If the Akademiya is hoarding something as convenient and useful like Canned Knowledge, then they must've been planning only to use it for themselves! Am I right?

choices.text: They must have their own reasons.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: The Akademiya has clearly published the potential dangers of Canned Knowledge. I don't like having to repeat things, and besides, I'm sure you wouldn't listen anyway.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: I just hope you understand that your actions are what fuels the smuggling of Canned Knowledge.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: If I ever catch you again, I will personally see to it that you are punished.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: #Alright, {NICKNAME}, I need to go now.

response.speaker: Mutair
response.text: Hah! Y—You think you can scare me?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Phew... {NICKNAME}, why don't we go talk to Dori? She's got loads of connections and might be able to tell us something about all this.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon remembers correctly, she's usually at the Palace of Alcazarzaray. Let's go!

choices.text: Cyno wasn't kidding when he said intel was hard to come by.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Dori about what happened with Cyno.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I see, I see... So that's the latest scoop! Heh, good thing you didn't rat me out. Otherwise, who knows where I'd have to be hiding to avoid attention.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know who is smuggling the Canned Knowledge?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: No idea, sorry. I've already cashed out of the Canned Knowledge business.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? You mean you stopped selling it?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: That's right. With so much Canned Knowledge flooding the market, it was becoming impossible to fetch decent prices anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Besides, it seems that group of smugglers has practically taken over the market. It's a little rule of mine to never fight for a share of someone else's market. If I'm gonna make Mora, it's gonna be the lion's share.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Plus, with regulations getting as tight as they are now, I figured I might as well just hang it up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, sounds like we came all this way for nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Well, not completely.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Granted, I don't know who's behind all the smuggling activity, but since you didn't sell me out, I'll let you in on what I do know.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: After all, those smugglers have really crossed the line, butting their way into the market like that. I hope their luck runs out soon so that I can take over... Ahem, I mean, so that the industry can become more fairly regulated.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you just want to make more business for yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is selling Canned Knowledge really that lucrative?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't underestimate its value. Think about it — you can gain all sorts of knowledge while bypassing the troublesome process of studying. Naturally, that makes it a product worth a high price.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Of course, not everyone needs that kind of knowledge, but in a market as big as Sumeru, there is plenty of demand. Plus, the cost of production is relatively low, so even if dealers have to cover transportation costs, there is still an enormous profit to be made.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then why does the Akademiya prohibit selling Canned Knowledge?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Hehe... Being able to gain complex knowledge and become a scholar with the snap of your fingers does sound like a dream, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: But everything in this world comes at a price, right?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Gaining knowledge is a complicated process — it requires learning, thinking, and practice. Even when it comes to my own business, I have to go through a lot of preparation before I put anything out for sale.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: But with Canned Knowledge, one may simply skip all the hassle and get whatever they need to know immediately. That inherently leads to at least two potential problems...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: First, you'll accept the knowledge as factual without a second thought, and you will find it very hard to forget. This means that if the knowledge is flawed, then it'll be very difficult to correct.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: And second, excess use of Knowledge Capsules over an extended time diminishes your ability to think. You'll end up becoming like a library that can only store knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa, that does sound pretty dangerous! {NICKNAME}, you used Canned Knowledge before. Did you feel any negative effects?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not in particular...

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Of course, using it sparingly is not an issue, which is exactly why I used to sell it.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: It's just like how medicine can be used to cure diseases, but can also do harm when overused. It all comes down to balancing the right amount.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Ahem, anyway back to the point, there'll be consequences if the sale of Canned Knowledge by those smugglers is left unchecked.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: And what's worse, you're playing right into their hands by focusing only on the Canned Knowledge that's made its way into the market.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: As far as I know, their real purpose is to distribute information about the Court of Desolation. That's where the real business opportunity is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Court of Desolation? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Rumor has it that it's a site of ruins from the age of King Deshret. It's said that with the treasures inside, one can see beyond life and death, but any research of the ruins is strictly banned by the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Word on the street is that there'll be an auction taking place in the desert. They're auctioning rare Canned Knowledge, some of which is related to the Court of Desolation.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Once I heard about the auction, I began to suspect that all the Canned Knowledge popping up on the market is just a diversion. I'd wager that their real target is the Court of Desolation.

choices.text: Why use Canned Knowledge to distribute information?

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: Because studying those ruins is not just a simple matter — it requires knowledge spanning several fields. So if they're aiming to quickly assemble a research team, Canned Knowledge would be the best solution.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: As for the auction, chances are they're trying to attract and scout out anyone with interest or expertise on the subject.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: On the other hand, no one can say for sure that they will ever succeed in finding the Court of Desolation. So they might as well just make a fortune while they're at it by hyping up the related Canned Knowledge at the auction.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmmm... sounds to Paimon like we better head to the desert and see the auction. Who knows, we might find some leads there.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: That's right! And now that I've shared all that valuable info with you, it's time to introduce our Limited Edition Desert Travel Kit! It comes complete with a map straight to the auction location.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Saw this coming...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: As I said, I also have to make preparations before I sell things, right? Now let me consider how much I should sell this for...

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: I've got it! 500,000 Mora per kit! It's quite the bargain. We'll even offer a 50% discount for little Paimon's travel kit. Only 250,000 Mora!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What! That's super expensive!

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: No need to worry, little one. Cyno's the one heading this investigation, isn't he? I'll be sure to bill all the expenses to him.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: All you'll need to do is tell him to go the merchant's guild and pay the bill once the mission is completed. Just, uh... be sure to not send him directly here though, okay? That would leave me completely in the open.

response.speaker: Dori
response.text: I'm sure the former General Mahamatra of the Akademiya would never leave any debt unpaid. Oh, the Mora... I can see it already, loads of shiny Mora coming Dori's way!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, we'd better get going. If Dori keeps at it, we'll be out of Mora!

choices.text: What's the purpose of hosting an auction?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cyno! We've got news for you! What the smugglers are really after is a chance to research the Court of Desolation!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They are hosting an auction in the desert to sell Canned Knowledge about those ruins!

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: The Court of Desolation...

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I won't ask how you came by this intel, but is it reliable?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We also heard that the Court of Desolation contains treasures from the time of King Deshret. Is that true?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Partially. It was a secret place built by a dark sect from the age of King Deshret. The ruins do contain treasures, but the place is also rife with unknown dangers.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: According to past research, one must forfeit their life as the price of entering. They are not some ordinary ruins, so the Akademiya has strictly prohibited any related research.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: However, if they are using the Canned Knowledge as a way to move information and recruit researchers, then I suppose your conclusion does hold some validity. Regardless, we need to go into the desert.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are there many people trying to study the Court of Desolation?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Less in recent years, but there are always those who attempt to do so, both inside and outside the Akademiya.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: After all, legends claim that whoever obtains the treasures inside can see beyond life and death, or even resurrect the dead.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Death is often the greatest grievance for many people. Though they're fully aware that the chances of these rumors being true are slim, they hold tight to such fantasies and pursue them regardless...

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: That's why some continue to research it, regardless of it being a restricted subject. On top of that, it's hard to track the source of information contained in Canned Knowledge.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Do you know where the auction is taking place?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, we do.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Good. We'll go investigate. But before that, we'll have to get rid of these people tailing us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? People tailing us?

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: That's right. Let's begin to leave town and see what happens. I'm sure they'll reveal themselves as soon as we make a move.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Don't worry. I'll make short work of them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's Cyno for ya... but we can lend a hand too, you know!

choices.text: It's all we have to go on for the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: By the way, it would be quite a tricky task to get all the Canned Knowledge off the market, don't you think? You'd probably be making some enemies along the way, too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What makes you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Because in the short run, the circulation of Canned Knowledge benefits everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: Whoever is behind the smuggling gets a chance to study the Court of Desolation, while knowledge dealers stand to make big profits. Even the buyers get a rare chance to easily access knowledge that is hard to come by.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: So you see, it's a win for everyone. Who would want anyone stepping in and ruining the deal, hmm?

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: As for the long-term consequences that lie ahead... Most people can't see them, nor would they even believe them. So if you think about it, you're setting yourself up to be targeted by everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: You've got quite the challenge ahead of you. I can only imagine how stressed you'll feel... How about I recommend a book for you? It's called One Hundred Ways to De-Stress and Live Your Best! I'll offer you a 30% discount right now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! Again!? No way we're falling for that!

dialogues.speaker: Jhuba
dialogues.text: Hold it right there. Heading to the desert, are we? I would think twice if I were you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Jhuba
dialogues.text: That doesn't matter. All you need to know is that someone wishes to inform you that it's not too late to turn back.

dialogues.speaker: Jhuba
dialogues.text: Ah, you must be Cyno. I've heard a lot about you — you've got quite a reputation. But this time, you're in over your head. Unless you turn around right now, I'm afraid that even you won't return unscathed.

dialogues.speaker: Jhuba
dialogues.text: And as for you two... why bother sticking your noses in trouble that doesn't even concern you, hmm?

choices.text: Canned Knowledge is becoming a problem here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. We won't just sit back and do nothing!

response.speaker: Jhuba
response.text: Heh, have you really thought it through? You're not just doing this for recognition, are you, Cyno?

response.speaker: Jhuba
response.text: My employer said that he's willing to compromise, as long as you just walk away. He could, for example, reduce the amount of Canned Knowledge on the market. I'm sure that would help your investigation appear to be successful enough.

response.speaker: Jhuba
response.text: On top of that, he's willing to give you a cut of the profit. So you see, you get both Mora and a boost to your reputation. I can't think of a reason why you would pass that up.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Is that so? Well, I can't think of a reason why I'd accept. I've heard enough, get out of my way.

response.speaker: Jhuba
response.text: Sorry, no can do. We're getting paid to ensure you disappear. Since you won't turn back willingly, then we're gonna have to make you go back.

talks.objective: Defeat the mercenaries that followed you

dialogues.speaker: Jhuba
dialogues.text: Ugh... this doesn't change anything.

dialogues.speaker: Jhuba
dialogues.text: You're in over your head, Cyno. There will be others coming for you. You'll regret it!

dialogues.speaker: Jhuba
dialogues.text: Let's get outta here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shouldn't we follow them?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: No need. Even if we apprehend them, there'll be little information to gain. Besides, it might also be a trap.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I apologize for bringing you into this dangerous mess. Just being associated with me will inevitably cause you to become targets as well.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: You should be careful from now on. Sleep with one eye open.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, hold on! There's no way anyone could sleep without closing their eyes... Uh, right?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: You'd be surprised. Anyway, just be careful. Mercenaries are never quick to forget. In their line of work, even a single failure is bad for reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: They may even stay hidden in some dark corner for a very long time, waiting for the right moment to ambush you. They'll do anything to keep their prestige intact.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you encountered that kind of situation before, Cyno?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Yes. I remember it like it was yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: I was carrying out a mission with one of my superiors. I didn't have much experience at the time, and I let my guard down after we had closed the case. We ended up being attacked by the remainder of the mercenaries.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: My superior was injured while protecting me, and we struggled to gain control of the situation. I've become more vigilant ever since, staying alert even while I sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, who could have seen that coming! Was he okay?

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: He survived with a fractured wrist. It took two months for him to recover, but luckily, there weren't any further complications. Last year, he transferred to an administrative role for personal reasons, and no longer participates in live missions.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: His name is Taj Radkani, a very well-respected matra. You will have the chance to meet him someday.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Anyway, our mission will be dangerous. I'm already used to such grueling conditions, but I don't want to see you two get hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Paimon will stay alert! We'll see danger coming a mile away!

choices.text: We've also experienced a lot of sticky situations.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: Good. Don't worry, it won't be long till we're at the bottom of this.

response.speaker: Cyno
response.text: And once this is all over, I'll sweep away any other hidden dangers.

dialogues.speaker: Nabil
dialogues.text: How's the case coming? Any progress?
Wait, you two! Just a moment, please!
#You're {NICKNAME} and Paimon, right? I thought you two looked familiar. People have been talking all about you.
It's a pleasure to meet you. Do you have a moment? There's something I'd like to discuss with you.

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: My name is Nabil. I'm a matra in the Akademiya. You're friends with Cyno, right? I've heard him mention you before.

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: Currently, Cyno is out investigating a case involving smuggled Canned Knowledge. It's been days since we've last heard from him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh no, do you think he's in trouble?

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: Uh, well... To be completely honest, it's pretty hard to imagine anything that could pose a threat to Cyno. But since we haven't heard from him, we're starting to suspect that the case might be more complicated than we had originally thought.

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: Word has it that you two are brave, smart, and extremely capable adventurers. Do you think you could lend us a hand and help investigate the smuggling?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, since you put it that way, we'll help!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you have any further intel regarding this case?

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: Large amounts of Canned Knowledge from unknown origins have been appearing on the market recently. Cyno suspected that there's a secret route being used to move the capsules.

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: According to some research, using large amounts of Canned Knowledge could lead to some serious consequences, and unfortunately, most people have yet to realize that.

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: Rumors also have it that some particularly dangerous Canned Knowledge has made its way into the market. Regardless of whether the rumors are true or not, this case calls for urgent action.

response.speaker: Nabil
response.text: Last we heard from Cyno, he was investigating somewhere outside Sumeru City. It seems that he had found some leads at the time, but we haven't heard from him since.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds like we'd better go look for him. C'mon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cyno, there you are! We finally found you!

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you two. I knew I sensed a familiar presence.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: But I'm very busy at the moment. We'll have to chat some other time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We heard about the case of smuggled Canned Knowledge.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right! Nabil asked us to come check on the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: So Nabil told you about this? Hmm, divulging my location without authorization... I'll let it slide for now — this isn't the time for that.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: The situation might be more problematic than you anticipated. I've already questioned several people, but gained very little information.

dialogues.speaker: Cyno
dialogues.text: Long story short, I was able to learn of the secret location where the Canned Knowledge is being sold. You're welcome to accompany me if you're interested.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, sounds pretty complicated. But having a chance to catch bad guys with Cyno, it's like we're a part of the matra!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, sign us up!

dialogues.speaker: Dori
dialogues.text: I'm sure the General Mahamatra of the Akademiya would never leave any debt unpaid, and I can only imagine the funds he's allocated for investigations... Oh, maybe I should charge him more!
